500,000 function invocations/month included. Runs on Deno globally. 256 MB memory limit, 150s wall clock duration limit, 2s CPU execution limit. WebSockets supported via Deno.upgradeWebSocket.

Unlimited bandwidth and unmetered static requests. 500 CI/CD builds/month (1 concurrent build, 20-min max build time). Up to 100 Pages projects and 100 custom domains per project. CLI uploads bypass build quota.

Executes on V8 isolates across Cloudflare edge network. 100,000 requests/day (~3M/month) on Free plan. 10 ms CPU execution time limit per request (I/O waiting unmetered), 128 MB RAM. Unlimited bandwidth. 5 Cron Triggers included.

$5.00/month recurring compute credit with no credit card required. Serverless background workers with checkpointing during waits. No hard execution duration limit. 20 concurrent runs, 10 cron schedules per project.

Free tier only available on public repositories (private repos require GitHub Pro/Team). 1 GB site size limit, 100 GB/month soft bandwidth limit, 10 builds/hour limit. Restricted: no commercial e-commerce/transactions.

New accounts receive a free trial granting up to 2 total VM-hours of runtime shared across Machines or 7 days (whichever ends first) with no credit card required. Machines auto-stop after 5 minutes of idle. Deploying beyond the 2 VM-hour trial requires adding a credit card on Pay As You Go, where monthly invoices under $5.00 are waived.

Monthly allowance of 1,500 OCPU-hours and 9,000 GB-hours supports 2 OCPUs and 12 GB RAM running continuously 24/7 (or scaling up to 4 OCPUs and 24 GB RAM if run part-time within the monthly hour limits). 200 GB block storage pool shared across Home Region. Idle reclamation applies if 95th percentile CPU, memory, and network stay under 20% over 7 days.

Up to 2 instances with 1/8 OCPU (burstable) and 1 GB RAM each in Home Region. Shares 200 GB block storage pool and 10 TB/month outbound bandwidth. Idle reclamation applies if 95th percentile CPU and network stay under 20% over 7 days.

notes: Requires Google Cloud account and Cloud Billing activation with a valid payment card. Phone verification is not a universal GCP requirement. Monthly recurring free allowance covers 2M requests, 360,000 vCPU-seconds, 180,000 GiB-seconds, and 1 GB outbound North America data transfer. Cloud Build includes 120 free build-minutes/day. Scales to zero on idle.

Perpetual free tier with no credit card required. Official Deno Deploy Pricing page (deno.com/deploy/pricing) specifies: 1,000,000 requests/month, 20 GiB outbound bandwidth, 15 builds/hour (1 concurrent), 10 active applications, 10 hours active CPU, 150 GiB-hr memory time, and 1 GiB Deno KV storage across 35+ global edge regions (legacy Deploy Classic was 100 GiB and 100k requests/day).
